summary: Operator site read: 2026 W/E $42 ($35 off-season), 20/30A, no sewer (dump station + pump-out), 116 sites; showers, laundry, WiFi; season May 1-Oct 12 written; unsourced 60-ft max cleared; phone booking; price gate passes; leans seasonal (see flags).
flags: PRIVATE GATE: W/E site $42 a night (May 1-Oct 12; $35 before Memorial Day/after Labor Day), operator's 2026 rate table at highlandcampground.com/rates.html read 2026-11-11 - under US$50. No gateway within 40 km (Hartford ~50 km, gateways.py); not needed. Good Sam: not a GS Park as far as stored data shows. Not stayed at by the family.

REVIEWS: Google Maps 'Highland Camp Ground' 4.1 from 72 reviews (phone +1 860-423-5684 = stored; pin 41.679378,-72.078268, ~150 m from stored 41.68070,-72.07808 - fine). RV Life 4.0 / $$ (stored). Not under 4.0.

LONG-STAY (borderline, leaning seasonal - reviewer's call): the home page headline is '2026 SEASONAL SITES AVAILABLE May 1 - October 12 $2,550', and the rate page sells monthly ($850 + metered electric), spring/fall weekend packages that leave the trailer on the site, and a weekday package; the rules require 'A camper must have a permanent residence'. But the operator also posts a nightly rate ($42) and weekly rate first in its table and takes holiday-weekend reservations (test 2 passes on a posted nightly rate). No online booking engine (phone/email only), so no occupancy check was possible. Recent Google reviews: 'Water, electric and Grey tank drainage, NO sewer, black tanks need to be pumped out' (4 months ago), 'Looking forward to our first season' (6 months), 'my family had a seasonal campsite...' (9 months), plus a tent-camping Halloween-weekend review (sites 71/72). Mixed seasonal/transient; not clearly mostly seasonal.
PRESENCE: highlandcampground.com answers 200 and is this park (42 Toleration Road, Scotland CT); phone 860-423-5684 on Google matches stored.
